title: St. Louis Blues solo from orchestration and his first band job with Bernard
summary: He learned the St. Louis Blues solo from an orchestration, then recalls his first job, substituting for Adolf Alexander in Ormer Bernard's band, and practicing to learn variations.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees
